description.value: You target a Medium or smaller droid or construct you can see, forcing a hard restart. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or become incapacitated until the start of your next turn. Whenever it takes damage or is targeted by a hostile power while incapacitated this way, it may attempt the save again, ending the effect early on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
